text:
```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'tooling/typescript-config/**'
      - 'scripts/tsconfig-future-audit.mjs'
      - 'packages/**/tsconfig.json'
      - 'apps/**/tsconfig.json'

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: useblacksmith/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: 'bun'

      - name: Install Bun
        run: npm i -g bun

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run TypeScript typecheck
        run: bun run typecheck

      - name: Run lint
        run: bun run lint

      - name: Run TS config audit
        run: node scripts/tsconfig-future-audit.mjs

      - name: Notify code owners
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v4
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          body: |
            👋 @${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}: This PR touches documentation and TypeScript configuration. Code owners, please review.
```
